interviews.title: Interview — Procurement Director, Example OEM
framing: Focus: Supplier qualification, capacity, and sourcing allocation
Note: The expert had direct visibility into compressor-side sourcing but limited visibility into hot-section casting

themes.lead: Qualification is staged rather than binary
points: The expert estimates that first-part approval takes 12–18 months for an experienced supplier, while full production maturity can take several years once repeat performance and reference history are included.
He was direct that vendors willing to reserve qualified capacity receive incremental share even when they are not the absolute lowest-cost option.
